The corrected general rule is 10 × 13^(n−1). Check: at position 2 the rule gives 130, matching the given second term.

option_rationales.10 × 14^(n−1): Incorrect: Counts one extra tile or term.
option_rationales.11 × 13^(n−1): Incorrect: Extends a constant difference where the pattern changes.
option_rationales.10 × 13^(n−1): Correct: Check: at position 2 the rule gives 130, matching the given second term.
option_rationales.10 × 3^(n−1): Incorrect: Uses the wrong position or rule parameter.
